name: Apple Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Butter a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Toss apple slices with granulated sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon, and lemon juice. Spread in dish.
Mix oats, flour, brown sugar, remaining cinnamon, and salt in a bowl.
Cut in cold butter with your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Bake 40-45 minutes until topping is golden and apples are bubbling.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use dairy-free butter and coconut whipped cream.
substitutions.gluten_free: Use gluten-free oats and a 1:1 gluten-free flour blend.
substitutions.vegan: Use coconut oil instead of butter.

notes: Granny Smith apples hold their shape best. Honeycrisp gives a sweeter result.
